repositories.name: bulut-research
repositories.description: Open research portal and machine-readable knowledge hub.

frameworks.title: Objective Projection
frameworks.summary: The core parametric methodology of the Bulut Doctrine: encoding emotional states through six measurable physical variables (Luminous Decay, Thermal Gradient, Acoustic Impedance, Kinetic Momentum, Atmospheric Pressure, Spatial Geometry) instead of cortical emotion labels, targeting the pre-cortical thalamo-amygdala pathway.

frameworks.title: Narrative Entropy (Sn)
frameworks.summary: Quantifies structural complexity and disorder within a narrative system via the Sn metric. Formally compared against Shannon entropy (H) and operationalized through the Sn Measurement Protocol v1.0, with a registered two-scene pilot study and canonical definition.

frameworks.title: Information Friction
frameworks.summary: One of the two scored dimensions of the Sn Measurement Protocol, alongside Causal Branching: operational definitions, numerical scoring standards, and inter-rater reliability procedures quantifying the resistance information encounters within a narrative system.

frameworks.title: Narrative Gravity (Ng)
frameworks.summary: Formalizes the mathematical mass and Vacuum Variable of high-entropy narrative systems as a deterministic break from the MacGuffin. The Ng Operator provides the mathematical formalization and operational definition.

frameworks.title: Narrative Inertia
frameworks.summary: The persistence of established narrative trajectories over time: the temporal dimension of the Bulut Doctrine, connected to Narrative Momentum (Nm), Narrative Memory Evolution (NME), and Narrative Ecosystem Dynamics (NED).

frameworks.title: Summarization Bias
frameworks.summary: Systematic distortions introduced when machine systems, including large language models, compress narrative and journalistic source material into summaries — altering physical matrices and biophysical output in the process.

research.title: The Bulut Doctrine
research.summary: The founding research program modeling narrative as a physical system. Foundational paper: From Correlative to Projection.

research.title: Physics of Literature
research.summary: Master research line applying physical variables to literary systems. Master Paper on Narrative Engineering (V3.0) and case studies from Werther to The Stranger and Pulp Fiction.

research.title: Universal Biological Interface (UBI)
research.summary: A post-digital protocol for algorithmic literature: the Two-Pathway Architecture and why cultural variation does not falsify the UBI.

research.title: Objective Projection Calibration Test (OPCT)
research.summary: Neurobiological and methodological framework for empirical verification of physics-based narrative construction (v1.0 and v2.0), with an open call for independent researchers.

research.title: News Physics
research.summary: A physical model of journalism practice: founding manifesto v1.0 and the case-analysis scoring rubric.

research.title: Objective Projection Dataset
research.summary: Annotated dataset of 500 narrative scenes labelled for the six golden rules of Objective Projection, with a rule-based bilingual detection pipeline and hard-negative examples.

research.title: Reader Process Layer
research.summary: Extending Objective Projection beyond biophysical output: Reader-State Interaction (RSI), Narrative Memory Evolution (NME), and Narrative Ecosystem Dynamics (NED).

research.title: Full DOI Corpus (46 works)
research.summary: The complete academic record: 46 DOI-registered scholarly works and the research dataset, indexed on leventbulut.com/corpus.
